title: Family Friendly Take A Kid Fishing Adventure in Murrells Inlet
blurb:
A perfect day out for families, the 4.5-hour “Take a Kid Fishing” trip invites young anglers to experience the thrill of deep sea fishing off Murrells Inlet. With all gear provided — including rods, reels, bait, and tackle — families can focus on the excitement of reeling in their first catch while our certified crew provides hands-on guidance throughout the trip. Target species typically include seasonal bottom fish such as sea bass and ringtail, and the crew is right there to help kids hook, reel, and land fish for a fun and successful first fishing experience.

This adventure takes place aboard a comfortable, U.S. Coast Guard certified vessel, equipped with restrooms, a snack bar, and a scenic observation deck for relaxing between bites. Designed for all ages and experience levels, this trip offers a safe, fun, and memorable introduction to fishing on the water.
